ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to distal tips and sparse ventral speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous dark pigmentation field. High-contrast white punctate spots are clustered in the lower-lateral region of the left lobe. Dense high-intensity white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression; calculated interior pixel angle approximately 135 degrees with low bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous moderate-frequency serration along the linear boundary. The right lobe distal edge displays higher-amplitude peaks/valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips. Sparse circular high-intensity spots distributed across the left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified epibiont clusters (barnacles) at both the left and right distal tips.
